page.overview:
Who is Vernon Fenwick?

Mutant rat (temporarily) Mutant turtle (temporarily) Mutant spider (temporarily)

Vernon Fenwick is a secondary human antagonist of the from the 1987 TV series.

Vernon Fenwick was a cameraman at in the 1987 TV series, who usually accompanied in her reports.

In general, Fenwick serves as a secondary human antagonist to the Turtles. Vernon Fenwick and often wrongfully blamed the Turtles for crimes they were seeking to prevent. Fenwick is an ambitious man. Sometimes Vernon Fenwick tried to take April's place as a news reporter. Still, his general unwillingness to take risks, his cowardice in the face of almost everything, his pride, and his certain clumsiness were his undoing.
